title: Content pipeline: the loop that sells
summary: Design → build → photos/clips → posts/ads → orders — manual first, AI optional, then guided for members.

blocks.title: Content does the selling
blocks.body: A three-second clip of rings snapping into a heart beats a paragraph of product copy. The pipeline is a loop: each order funds the next design, and each design feeds the next clip.

nodes.title: Design
nodes.detail: Shape, color map, size, and who it is for.

nodes.title: Build
nodes.detail: Make one real piece — proof, not mockup-only.

nodes.title: Posts + ads
nodes.detail: Captions, schedule, listings, light paid boost.

nodes.title: Orders
nodes.detail: Single, small batch, or bulk — then back to design.

blocks.heading: Three maturity stages
items: Stage 1 — Manual: founders design, build, shoot, and post by hand. Prove stranger sales before tools.
Stage 2 — Optional AI: mockups, caption drafts, color variants. Humans still approve and fulfill.
Stage 3 — Guided: members follow playbooks; the collective supplies templates, not a requirement to use AI.

blocks.heading: Asset checklist per design
rows: The ad that needs no copy

blocks.title: AI is optional, never required
blocks.body: Members can run the whole loop with phone camera and notes. Tools speed mockups and captions; they do not replace a real built piece or honest QC.
